mapper.insert: ON CONFLICT (nx, ny, base_date, base_time) DO NOTHING

ON CONFLICT (nx, ny, base_date, base_time) DO UPDATE SET pty = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.pty, tb_ultra_srt_ncst.pty), reh = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.reh, tb_ultra_srt_ncst.reh), rn1 = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.rn1, tb_ultra_srt_ncst.rn1), t1h = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.t1h, tb_ultra_srt_ncst.t1h), uuu = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.uuu, tb_ultra_srt_ncst.uuu), vec = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.vec, tb_ultra_srt_ncst.vec), vvv = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.vvv, tb_ultra_srt_ncst.vvv), wsd = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.wsd, tb_ultra_srt_ncst.wsd)
mapper.sql: CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('PTY', weather.pty::numeric), ('REH', weather.reh), ('RN1', weather.rn1), ('T1H', weather.t1h), ('UUU', weather.uuu), ('VEC', weather.vec), ('VVV', weather.vvv), ('WSD', weather.wsd) ) AS item(category, obsr_value)
mapper.select:
SELECT weather.base_date, weather.base_time, weather.nx, weather.ny, item.category, item.obsr_value::text AS obsr_value, weather.c_date FROM ( SELECT * FROM public.tb_ultra_srt_ncst WHERE nx = #{nx} AND ny = #{ny} ORDER BY base_date DESC, base_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) weather
WHERE item.obsr_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY item.category
